create_distributed_deterministic_sampler: create a DistributedDeterministicSampler to split dataset indices across distributed ranks in round-robin order
create_distributed_random_sampler: create a DistributedRandomSampler to sample dataset indices with randomness for distributed training
create_weighted_random_sampler: create a DistributedRandomSampler with weights to perform weighted sampling with replacement across ranks
shuffle_distributed_random_sampler: shuffle a DistributedRandomSampler by calling shuffle with a new seed to get a different index order
iterate_deterministic_sampler: iterate over a DistributedDeterministicSampler to yield disjoint indices assigned to the current rank
